contract.text: A deploy (which restarts the scheduler) lands inside a scheduler sleep window and never on a decisive live observation day.
contract.source: CLAUDE.md 'Deploys restart the scheduler' (a151ebf, 2026-07-02; written after the event, no earlier written rule)

mechanism.text: every push to deploy restarts bts-scheduler with no check of the scheduler's current window; the 6/22 push (run 27996097986, 21:35:58 ET) landed on a skip day, so the day's end ran on newly installed #144/#145 finalization code (decision.json writer, skip-day gates)

mitigated.action: operator guidance: check the scheduler's 'Sleeping until' journal line before a midday deploy and never deploy on a decisive observation day (CLAUDE.md)

residual.text: No mechanical guard: deploy timing relies on the documented sleep-window check; a restart inside a lineup-check or result-polling window is Route R's V9 candidate class
residual.source: CLAUDE.md 'Deploys restart the scheduler'; design §6.2 V9

watchdog.trigger: a deploy run's restart falls inside an evidenced active scheduler window (lineup check, fallback, result polling) or before the day's finalization record is written
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the day still ends with a finalization record (committed selection or deliberate skip) written by one code version
